name: CUMYL-4CN-BINACA
summary: CUMYL-4CN-BINACA (also known as CUMYL-CYBINACA or SGT-78) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.12 nM, respectively.1 mg in humans.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist for cannabinoid receptors CB1 and CB2, with in vitro EC50 values of 0.58 nM and 6.12 nM, respectively. CUMYL-4CN-BINACA is metabolized to produce cyanide, raising concerns about liver toxicity.

uses.text: CUMYL-4CN-BINACA (also known as CUMYL-CYBINACA or SGT-78) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. It has been linked to deaths, and its breakdown releases cyanide, raising concern about liver damage. Synthetic cannabinoids like it can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。它已與死亡案例有關，而且分解時會釋出氰化物，引發對肝臟損傷的疑慮。這類合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。它已与死亡案例有关，而且分解时会发布氰化物，引发对肝脏损伤的疑虑。这类合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状与癫痫发作。

fact.en: The cumyl in its name is the same chemical group found in cumene, an industrial chemical made in huge amounts to produce phenol and acetone.
fact.zh: 名稱中的 cumyl 與異丙苯（cumene）中的化學基團相同，異丙苯是大量生產、用來製造苯酚與丙酮的工業化學品。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的 cumyl 与异丙苯（cumene）中的化学基团相同，异丙苯是大量生产、用来制造苯酚与丙酮的工业化学品。
